Churchill Aesthetics is your doctor-led cosmetic clinic run by long-time Ipswich resident Dr Kristina Dennett. Working as a doctor in the Ipswich area since 2008 and branching out into Skin related medicine in 2015; Dr Dennett has been caring for the local community helping patients feel better on both the inside and outside.

​

Are you a "Giver", dedicating your time to everyone around you but yourself? We are passionate about accompanying you on your path to self-care!

We bring a new level of aesthetic care to Ipswich. We offer treatments for smoothening lines and wrinkles, cosmetic solutions for volume loss, MesoPen Pro skin needling, PRP and exosome therapy, bio-remodelling and collagen inducing treatments, PDO mono threads, LED light therapy, and the industry leading APTOS thread lifting (non-surgical facelift).

Please follow our Treatment Menu for in-depth information to find out what we can do for you!
